answer_1.quote: We propose DIONY-SUS, a pre-trained sequence-to-sequence model designed to summarize dialogues in any domain, even with a lack of labeled data.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores to evaluate generated summaries against references. We also use ROUGE-1-F1, ROUGE2-F1, ROUGEL-F1, and ROUGELSum-F1.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the performance of DIONYSUS by conducting human evaluation experiments on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Participants are asked to rate the summaries on a scale of 1 to 5, with higher scores indicating better quality.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated summary on a 1‑5 scale, where higher scores indicate better overall quality.
